advisories.fix: In a hidden session, run `sudo apt-get update` and `sudo apt-get full-upgrade`, and install or remove there what the decoy installed or removed, so hidden sessions record the same packages. See "Package changes in hidden sessions" in docs/operator-guide.md.
advisories.message: the decoy installed, updated or removed 1 package since hidden sessions made their own copy of the dpkg package database (/var/lib/dpkg/status), which still records them as they were: acl (2.3.2-1build1.1 on the decoy, 2.3.2-1build1.1+hidden in hidden sessions)
advisories.name: package-drift
